clips.title: Trending Audio
clips.content:
5 clips + supercut so far (all new, 0 repeats). Overnight run failed on usage; rebuilt live at 6 AM.

SHOW OPENER SUPERCUT: GTA 6 LAUNCH DAY (0:20)
Global News: "GTA 6 is expected to be the biggest video game release of all time" / WarGames (1983, Movieclips): "Shall we play a game?" / Ready Player One (2018): "You can do anything. Go anywhere... except for eating, sleeping and bathroom breaks, whatever people want to do, they do it in the Oasis." / Aliens (1986): "Game over, man!" Straight into AJ's intro ending on Showtime.
PLAY · READY · Clean. Aliens bite trimmed tight between swears; Aliens and Ready Player One from fan uploads.

GTA 6: FANS' FIRST PLAY (ABC NEWS AUSTRALIA) (0:57)
SET UP: Australia and New Zealand got GTA 6 first. "Here's ABC News Australia." IN: "Well, gamers around the world are finally playing Grand Theft Auto 6..." OUT: "...let's just see what we can get up to." Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I5-aJTRstzM
PLAY or TALK-OVER · READY · FLAG: a fan claims a '99 on Metacritic' (not verified, don't repeat as fact). Network audio: station OK or talk over.

GTA 6: GRAND THEFT PTO (CNN) (0:19)
SET UP: "CNN says your coworker may have the GTA flu." Gusto saw a 9% spike in PTO requests; an economist predicts half a million gamers call in sick. IN: "This is also a grand theft PTO..." OUT: "...I enjoy my job." Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hDxIch5H7iE
TALK-OVER or quick PLAY · READY · Network audio: station OK or talk over. Clean.

GORDON RAMSAY'S SHIRTLESS 60TH (KIMMEL) (0:30)
SET UP: "Gordon Ramsay turned 60 and posted a shirtless pic. Here's how that happened, from Jimmy Kimmel Live." IN: "By the way, congratulations and happy birthday to you..." OUT: "He was under the bed." (laughter) Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J7F_L3h5Osw
PLAY · READY · Clean. Partly references a photo on screen; the joke lands on audio.

BRAD UPTON: DIE AT THE IN-LAWS' ON THANKSGIVING (DRY BAR) (0:45)
SET UP: "Brad Upton from Dry Bar Comedy has Thanksgiving plans." IN: "If I told you I was going to teach you how to fish..." OUT: "...He hated doing that." Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NlWZtCBjRZA
PLAY · READY · FLAG: dark joke about dying. Clean language.

HALF MARATHON STICKER + TURKEY TROT (DRY BAR) (1:25)
SET UP: "Thanksgiving morning runners, this one's for you, from Dry Bar Comedy." IN: "So, buddy of mine just ran a half marathon..." OUT: "...throwing up in the bushes?" Source: Dry Bar Comedy 'Thanksgiving Is Painful' https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LPcFMf8x-S0
PLAY · READY · Clean. Pairs with the Cadillac 'B' Thankful 5K. Comedian name not shown in compilation title; credit Dry Bar Comedy.
